slides.text: some strangers feel like [[an umbrella tilted over your shoulder]] for three steps in the rain, then they are gone.

caption:
you never got their name, but you still remember the bright red jacket.
quiet people keep the whole street running on bad weather days.
send this to the friend who always holds the heavy glass door for the person rushing behind them.

#kindnessmatters #randomactsofkindness #kindnessquotes
